text: Really they must come out of the cart, Master Copperfield!’ ‘I don’t understand you,’ said I. ‘Don’t you, though?’ he returned, with one of his jerks. ‘I’m astonished at that, Master Copperfield, you being usually so quick! I’ll try to be plainer, another time.---Is that Mr. Maldon a-norseback, ringing at the gate, sir?’ ‘It looks like him,’ I replied, as carelessly as I could. Uriah stopped short, put his hands between his great knobs of knees, and doubled himself up with laughter.
